title: Skip the Odds
goal: Skip odd numbers and accumulate only even values in a loop.

source.attribution: adapted from Day 1 Morning: Control Flow Basics

hints: `break` exits the entire loop on the first odd number.
Choose the keyword that skips the rest of the current iteration.
explanation: `continue` skips the remaining statements in the current turn and jumps to the next iteration. `break` terminates the loop entirely, which would stop the sum on the first odd number. Using `return` would exit the entire function immediately.
